anemometer_drift.summary: nacelle anemometer gain drifts linearly to +-m % (sign drawn per event); the second anemometer is untouched

clock_shift.summary: all channels of one device are delayed by m minutes against the others (logger clock error)

derating.summary: active power capped at (1 - m %) of rated power; power, current and energy move together

flatline.summary: sensor stuck at its first value of the window (wind speed of a turbine, plane-of-array irradiance of a met station)

inverter_outage.summary: inverter produces nothing for the duration of the window (power and currents zero)

nacelle_dir_offset.summary: nacelle position sensor offset by +-m degrees (step); the vane and the absolute direction are untouched

power_loss.summary: active power reads (1 - m %) of the true value at every power level (underperformance)

pyranometer_drift.summary: plane-of-array irradiance gain drifts linearly to +-m % (soiling, ageing; sign drawn per event)

shading.summary: a fixed obstacle in the west shades the plant at low sun in the afternoon: power scales by (1 - m %) when the sun is below 30 deg and west of south-west

string_loss.summary: a share of the strings of an inverter is lost: AC and DC power and current scale by (1 - m %)

thermal_drift.summary: temperature channel drifts linearly to +m K (gearbox oil of a turbine, heat sink of an inverter)

unit_jump.summary: temperature logged in degF instead of degC (gearbox oil of a turbine, module temperature of a met station)

cusum.description: two-sided CUSUM of every residual clipped at 5 sigma, on hourly values (allowance 1 sigma, memory 3 days), largest statistic
cusum.title: CUSUM chart

ewma.description: exponentially weighted moving average of every residual clipped at 5 sigma (time constant about one day), largest standardised value
ewma.title: EWMA chart

iforest.description: Isolation Forest (100 trees, 4096 samples) on the vector of standardised residuals; missing residuals set to 0
iforest.title: Isolation Forest

nbm_gbm.description: wind-thermal-nbm GBMModel: gradient boosting on the same inputs and their trailing means (1-12 h) for the gearbox oil temperature; the standardised residual is the score
nbm_gbm.title: Thermal model (GBM)

nbm_rc.description: wind-thermal-nbm RCModel: first-order thermal model of the gearbox oil temperature from load, rotor speed, nacelle and ambient temperature; the standardised residual is the score
nbm_rc.title: Thermal model (RC)

power_curve_kpi.description: res-asset-kpi bin_power_curve per turbine on the training weeks; the standardised residual of power against the curve at the measured wind speed is the score
power_curve_kpi.source: res-asset-kpi: res_asset_kpi.wind.bin_power_curve, curve_power (the method of wind-power-curve-kelmarsh)
power_curve_kpi.title: Power curve (method of bins)

pv_autoencoder.description: pv-anomaly-autoencoder AutoencoderDetector per inverter: windows of 8 steps of power, performance ratio, irradiance, clear-sky index, temperatures and sun position; the reconstruction error (mse), smoothed over one hour, is the score; trained for at most 100 epochs on 80 % of the training days
pv_autoencoder.title: Autoencoder (PV)

pv_outage_expected.description: pv-outage-classifier detectors.score('expected'): shortfall of inverter power against a PVWatts-style model driven by the met station's irradiance and module temperature, calibrated per bin on the table that is scored (as in that repository); shortfall only
pv_outage_expected.title: Shortfall vs PVWatts model

pv_outage_iforest.description: pv-outage-classifier detectors.score('iforest'): Isolation Forest on that repository's step features (residuals, level, sun position, ...), fitted on the table that is scored, as in that repository
pv_outage_iforest.title: Outage features + Isolation Forest

rules.description: fixed physical rules, no learning: the two anemometers differ by more than 1.5 m/s, a wind speed with zero variation over an hour while the turbine produces, gearbox oil outside -20 to 100 degC, vane + nacelle - absolute direction beyond 25 deg, power above 110 % of rated; PV: irradiance frozen in daylight, inverter below 2 % of rated in sun above 300 W/m2, module temperature outside -30 to 90 degC, power above 110 % of rated
rules.title: Expert rules

scada_qc.description: rows flagged by the row-level checks of scada_schema.qc (flatline, spikes, out of range, units, power curve, wind direction, energy counter, energy against power)
scada_qc.title: scada-schema QC

zscore.description: largest absolute residual of the shared features (one-hour median), each divided by its 99.5 % quantile on the training weeks so that no single heavy-tailed feature decides the score
zscore.title: Robust z-score
